_readme: Town hub configs for tools/town-hubs/setup-town-hub.macro.js. Door x/y/w/h are RENDER pixels of the export at refWidth (the runner scales to the imported scene + padding). Scenes by name or 'Scene.<id>'. beatMap rows: [beatIdPrefix, doorKey, 'exterior'|'interior'] or [prefix, '@Scene name', '']. Beats whose ids are in hubBeats (or the hex's arrival beats) land on the hub map. Only empty/dangling sceneIds are written unless the beat is in overrideLiveBeats or the scene is in replaceSceneNames.

doors.label: The Vacancy
doors.blurb: An L-shaped motel folded into the wall's elbow. VACANCY, says the sign, and it is not lying: it never is. Verna keeps the ledger; the ledger keeps everyone else.

doors.label: The Waiting Room
doors.blurb: The door still says EMERGENCY. Inside it says WAITING ROOM, over the bar, and the triage chairs face the counter now. Doc Greeley pours. Nobody here has ever been told to take a number and liked it.

doors.label: The Long Market
doors.blurb: Old Main Street, roofed over in welded awnings and stubbornness. Everything is for sale down the row, including opinions. Etta Bloom is somewhere in the middle of it, which is where the middle is.

doors.label: The Leygate
doors.blurb: EMERGENCIES ONLY, says the sign, and under it, in a different hand: AND EVEN THEN, ASK GARREN. The gate hums like someone pretending they aren't tired. Blue flickers yellow. Yellow flickers blue.

doors.label: The Muster
doors.blurb: The gutted fire station by the North Gate. A boot is nailed to the door. Over the arch somebody has painted GOOD VIBES ONLY! and somebody else has not painted over it, which tells you who runs the drills.

doors.label: The North Gate
doors.blurb: The North Gate: Thatwards-by-North starts here, and so does everything that comes down that road at night. Rotations are checked. Rotations are checked again. The crane is not decorative.

doors.label: The East Wall
doors.blurb: One section of wall leans inward like it is listening for something under the ground. Beyond it: scrub, wind, and things that do not respect fences. On this side: people who would like to sleep tonight.

doors.label: Plumb's Tower
doors.blurb: The base of the old water tower is an office now. The wall is visible through Aldous Plumb's window. It is leaning. He has arranged his desk so that his back is to it.

notes: The Crossroads has its own scene but no place on either map — reachable through Pike's HQ choices; add a door later if you site it.

doors.label: The Water Choir
doors.blurb: Stone-lined channels, hand-carved, gravity-fed. Notes rise where the channels narrow; low tones hum in the wide basins. The children who tune them are terrifying and correct. One basin never tunes. Nobody skips it by accident.

doors.label: The East Channels
doors.blurb: The east irrigation channels, where the scrub starts. Something has been tearing them up at night, and every channel it touches points the same way: toward the Green Ring. It is not subtle. It may not be malicious. Elsin would like a second opinion.

doors.label: The Forest That Will Not Be Fought
extra: Forest of Early Tipahret hexhchrome battlemap
doors.blurb: The treeline outside Lyrenn has started editing the fence line, a stride closer every morning. Nobody has seen a tree move. Everybody has seen where it was yesterday. Rowan says it is not angry. Rowan says that like it matters.

doors.label: The Co-op
doors.blurb: The reinforced shell of the old agricultural co-op: tanks, a windmill, solar cloth strung between poles like tired flags. Elsin's table is co-op plank, scrubbed pale. You sleep in the loft above it, when you sleep.

doors.label: The Field That Remembers You
doors.interior: the field that remembers you hexchrome battlemap
doors.blurb: The low field, where the rows end. Unharvested, and not by neglect: the plants stand in postures. At the field's edge, half-buried where the furrows stop, a stone figure kneels. The furrows bend around it. They always have.

notes: Rowan has no door of his own — he is met where the rows end (the low Field) and in the co-op's extra scenes.

doors.label: The Brace
doors.blurb: The Brace holds back a section that already fell once. Timber, iron, and arithmetic older than the coalition, chalked straight onto the beams. Calder works underneath it. He does not look up when it groans, which tells you how often it groans.

doors.label: The Yard
doors.blurb: Ore carts in procession. Cranes frozen mid-lift like the skeletons of failed gods. Floodlights that burn all day, not for visibility. For warning. Something in the yard has a number, a label, and a destination, and it is not happy about any of the three.

doors.label: The Warehouse
doors.blurb: Warehouses dominate the skyline. Everything here has a number, a label, or a destination, and the quartermasters would like it noted that the shelves are emptier than the ledgers say. Khezek-Tor keeps the warehouses and does the complaining.

notes: The Seal, Level Four and the sink are underground — reached through the Lift Hall door, not a surface door. The Seal beats point at the Seal POV so the Quest Log lights the dome.

notes: floor = the level NAME (confirmed live: Mall of Forgotten Yesterdays Ground Floor 0–40, Second Floor 41–80; loose match).
Door rectangles are placed off the gridded stills (ref 4000x4000 per floor); nudge x/y/w/h after the first apply.
Only Donny's frontage is ungated. Every interior region is gated on enc_forgotten_yesterdays_donny_good; an unmet gate replays Donny on the Wall at the table (GM seat).

Placed off the REAL scene background the-maneuver-vault-hexchrome-battlemap.webm (1700x3700), bottom = road. Order bottom→top: entrance chevron, cubby corridor (foyer), vortex pool (echo archive), hex-tile floor (slippage), plasma dome (containment loop / Diorama POV).
Single level, walk-in regions, no gates: the door plays regardless.

The live foyer_of_procedure beat still points at the Diorama scene (the plasma-dome room); the runner leaves live scene ids alone. If the foyer should show Vault Foyer, add maneuver_vault_foyer_of_procedure to overrideLiveBeats.

doors.label: The Stage
doors.blurb: The arch, the two marks, the lake holding its breath. Step onto the island and the show starts.

notes: Placed off gloomgill-perch-hexchrome-battlemap.webm (5900x4600, the live level background); scene is 9000x6750 so the runner scales per axis.
Arrival + the fight stay on the battlemap; the stage island (arch + the two eye sigils) is the walk-in door into the POV, and the whole show plays there.
Applause = the long bench on the island's west side (the audience). Scoreboard = the end of the north pier. Both are direct doors; their own requires decide whether they play.
Ungated: the stage is the quest. Single level.
